summary: Nebius Group N.V. filed a Form 6-K on August 12, 2026, reporting unaudited consolidated financial results for Q2 2026 and publishing a shareholder letter. The filing includes revenue of $582.3 million (up 454% YoY), adjusted EBITDA of $236.2 million, and a net loss of $190.4 million. This is a routine earnings announcement, not a special-situation event. No transactional, restructuring, or strategic corporate action is disclosed. The filing is incorporated by reference into existing shelf registration statements. As a routine earnings release, it does not qualify as a special situation; watch for subsequent strategic or capital-allocation announcements.
